contexts.text: The cedar, the myrtle, and the tree of oil () = the truths and goods of the interior man. AC 10261:5.
The myrtle and the wood of oil () = spiritual good and celestial good. AE 375:33.
To set in the desert the cedar of shittah, the myrtle, and the tree of oil () = to give rational truths and the perception of them... The myrtle = lower rational truth.
